Name: Title Screen mod - Spouses' Easter Egg
Author: Pudassassin
Description:
At the title screen, have you try clicking the letter E in "STARDEW"? This mod do a slight change to that and replace them with spouse of your choice. Now you can greet your love before continue the game :D

(Hint : also try clicking the leaves hanging from the sign, too!)

[url=https://pudassassin.tumblr.com/post/156029254019/pudassassin-back-to-the-farming-maybe-with-her]Video Example[/url]
GIF Example : [url=https://pudassassin.tumblr.com/post/165399001159/from-this-one-i-had-made-for-myself-now-i-have]Ladies[/url] & [url=https://pudassassin.tumblr.com/post/165399031809/from-this-one-i-had-made-for-myself-now-i-have]Gentlemen[/url]

Note:
A: These easter egg animations only animate once until you reopen the game (GIF examples are looped)
B: Doesn't work on Chinese Title Screen

Instruction

Step 1
Unpack the zip file. Select your marriage candidate

Step 2
Navigate to the game directory: <Stardew Valley>\Content\Minigames

There should be one of these directory (depend on your purchase/system)
- "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Minigames"
- "C:\Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Minigames"

Step 3
Back up original files (make copies of them somewhere else)

Step 4
Replace the files there with ones from selected spouse's folder

Step 5
Knock the door (click the letter E on "STARDEW" 10 times)

Surprise your love! <3
